face.flavorText: 她冥想了两个星期，心无旁骛地探知着宇宙的每一个角落，事无巨细，无所不包。当她从冥想中醒来，口中只吐出了一个声音：“喔。”

face.name: Farseer Wo
face.text: Elusive After you cast a spell,& Discover a Nature spell from the past.
face.flavorText: For two weeks, she meditated in silence, undisturbed as she peered into the endless, unfolding facets of the universe. No pathway lay unexplored, no stone left unturned. When she finally snapped from her fugue, she uttered a single word: "Woah."

rule_sources.policy: Official27.4.2 changed Elemental Destruction Overload5 to2; pinned complete row agrees.
Official Schemes grow while retained in hand.
Freeze original recipients; each health event/reaction resolves in original play order.
One enemy minion is legal after14.6; damage both selected minions before reactions.
Actual overloaded crystals; excess of one increment not carried to the next printed stage.

policies.ranged_damage: Crackle uniformly selects3,4,5,6; Elemental Destruction has one independent4/5 branch per original active living minion in entry order; ordinary captured health effects handle reactions/stale residence.
policies.rank: Existing monotone5/10maximum-crystal ManaRankFamily in hand/deck; original target and one random currently adjacent active minion share one ordinary damage batch.
policies.scheme: Existing physical HandProgressSpec, initial1; repeat at each actual owner start while in hand; ordinary all-minion SPELL DamageBatch.
policies.stone: Actual overload_added ledger witness and event.amount, goal3 per hand stage; per-increment overflow discarded; existing clear_local cost upgrade; one/two/three ordinary current copies via original presence and cause.
policies.fork: Player-observation use_rule requires one active enemy minion for manual play; existing distinct random damage batch selects up to2, then ordinaryOverload2; automatic casts may fizzle.

uncertainties: Scheme owner-start tick, ranged-AOE reaction order, adjacent non-minion blockers, stale-recipient RNG sampling and per-increment Spellstone overflow/cost reset remain local policies pending CN edge calibration.
Version/hotfix and CN calibration deferred. Complete Shaman71 stays unbound; registration is not complete effect/pool support.
